proof_obligation: Explain why an inexact cube in [a^8, (a^4+1)^2) can occur, and why this n is even.

nearby_cubes.note: 97 is not near a cube (4^3=64, 5^3=125). This is not an exact left-endpoint hit.

possible_lemma: An inexact interval cube need not be forbidden; odd a does not force odd n. The remaining claim is: inexact cube implies n even.
